Talent0_2Ability.name: White Stork
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects:
Can use the <skill mainSkill=301050>[Special Load]</skill> code. At start of action, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=3010502>[Reinforced Ammo]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>3</color> times.
Sniper Rifle Weight: <color=#F74848>-15%</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: White Stork
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Can use the <skill mainSkill=301050>[Special Load]</skill> code. At start of action, gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=3010502>[Reinforced Ammo]</buf>. Stacks up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times. Each stack grants <color=#F74848>5%</color> additional Crit Rate, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.
Sniper Rifle Weight: <color=#F74848>-15%</color>.

300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

301003.name: Leisure
301003.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if this attack lands a critical hit, the target cannot retaliate.

301004.name: Nowhere To Run
301004.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. When in the <buf ID=3010504>[Improved Fire]</buf> state, applies <buf ID=900049>[Exposure II]</buf> to the part hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. A single unit can only be affected by <color=#F74848>1</color> type of Hit Boost effect at a time.

301005.name: Synchronized Command
301005.SpecificEffects: When in the <buf ID=3010504>[Improved Fire]</buf> state, applies <buf ID=7100303>[DMG UP II]</buf> to allies engaging in <buf ID=900002>[Link Attacks]</buf> after combat. Lasts for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

301006.name: Shower
301006.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to shoot a target <color=#F74848>2</color> times, with each shot dealing <color=#F74848>0.75x</color> DMG. If this attack does not destroy a part when in the <buf ID=3010504>[Improved Fire]</buf> state, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> after combat. Cannot move before attacking.

301007.name: Amassment
301007.SpecificEffects: At end of action, for each <buf ID=900073>[Special Load]</buf> executed during this action, <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> multiplier <color=#F74848>+0.15</color>, up to <color=#F74848>0.75</color>. Lasts until the start of the next action.

301008.name: Trump Card
301008.describe: Immediately gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=3010502>[Reinforced Ammo]</buf>. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

301009.name: Tracking Shot
301009.describe: Uses a Sniper Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. This attack is guaranteed to hit. When in the <buf ID=3010504>[Improved Fire]</buf> state, also inflicts <buf ID=900050>[Dodge Invalid]</buf> on the target hit after combat, which expires after being hit <color=#F74848>1</color> time.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300031.name: Forbidden Zone 1
300031.SpecificEffects: With a Ranged Weapon, launch <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> before the enemy attack within range, dealing <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300034.name: Forbidden Zone 2
300034.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

300035.name: Forbidden Zone 3
300035.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.5</color>.

300036.name: Forbidden Zone 4
300036.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf> is launched against an enemy that has not attacked. Targets the part with the lowest HP.

301041.name: Far Ahead 1
301041.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if the target is destroyed, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=3010502>[Reinforced Ammo]</buf> after combat. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301044.name: Far Ahead 2
301044.SpecificEffects: When in the <buf ID=3010504>[Improved Fire]</buf> state, gains an additional <color=#F74848>10%</color> Crit Rate.

301045.name: Far Ahead 3
301045.SpecificEffects: When in the <buf ID=3010504>[Improved Fire]</buf> state, gains an additional <color=#F74848>1%</color> Crit DMG for every <color=#F74848>5%</color> Crit Rate, up to <color=#F74848>10%</color>.

301046.name: Far Ahead 4
301046.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=3010502>[Reinforced Ammo]</buf> gained at start of action is increased to <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks.
